title: Ordinary local models under completed-to-continuous rational coefficient transport
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite with integer ring $A$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be noetherian, $B_X$ the completed coefficient ring [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and $i:B_X\simeq C(-,A)$ a ring-sheaf isomorphism carrying the completed scalar map to constant continuous integral functions. Put $\alpha=i$ followed by $C(-,A)\to C(-,E)$. For every $B_X$-module sheaf $M$ that is integral stratified finitely presented [def-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-module], the rational extension $\alpha_!M$ has a finite locally closed stratification [def-constructible-stratification] on each of whose strata its ordinary ringed inverse image from X is finite locally free over the inverse-image rational coefficient ring. For every finitely presented ordinary $A$-module $N$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module], there is an isomorphism of rational module sheaves $\alpha_!\operatorname{integralConstantModule}(N)\simeq C(-,E)\otimes_{E_X^c}(E\otimes_A N)_X^c$, where both constant-module functors are the project constant sheafification functors [def-sf-site-constant-module-functor]. This is an ordinary sheaf assertion, independent of derived categories and raw rationalization; no flatness of N is assumed.

proof.text: First use the completed constant-model transport to cancel restriction along pbcCompletedComparison. Compare integralConstantModule with the continuous constant model after extension by i. The scalar square identifies their coefficient units. Both constant module sheafifications are left adjoint to evaluation of global constant sections after the corresponding scalar restriction, so uniqueness of left adjoints yields a natural comparison preserving their units. Successive scalar extension is left adjoint to composite restriction. Its canonical comparison is tensor reassociation, e tensor (b tensor n) mapping to eb tensor n; no flatness assumption is involved.

proof.text: Compose this comparison with RationalStratum.reassociation and RationalStratum.scalarModels. The resulting comparison is the stated ordinary model formula. For each finite-presentation local integral model, commute inverse image and slice restriction with this localization using the normalized coefficient square, and apply RationalStratum.chosenLocalModel. A basis of E tensor_A N gives a finite-power rational model, including rank zero for torsion modules.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2; Definition 6.8.10; Proposition 6.8.11(3); construction of Proposition 6.8.14(2)

proof.text: Use the original finite stratification and its covering sieves. Normalized coefficient pullback is an isomorphism. Restricting a finite-power module across that coefficient isomorphism gives the same finite-power inverse-image module. Thus the local free models certify IsFiniteLocallyFree over the original inverse-image rational ring on each stratum. Convert the stratification to FiniteLocallyClosedStratification, retaining its strata and immersions. Empty strata and empty schemes satisfy the same covering argument.

theorem rationalModuleLocalModelsTransport (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (i : pbcAdicCompletion X (pbcIntegralDatum l E) ≅ integralCoefficientSheaf l X E)
    (_hi : pbcCompletedScalar X (pbcIntegralDatum l E) ≫ i.hom =
      (letI := coefficientExtensionNormedField l E
       continuousCoefficientConstantComparison X (PbcIntegralRing l E))) :
    (∀ M : pbcModules X (pbcAdicCompletion X (pbcIntegralDatum l E)),
      IsIntegralStratifiedFinitelyPresented X (pbcIntegralDatum l E) M →
        ∃ s : FiniteLocallyClosedStratification X, ∀ k : Fin s.n,
          ((proEtaleModuleInverseImage (s.immersion k)
            (rationalCoefficientSheaf l X E)).obj
              ((pbcExtend (i.hom ≫ integralRationalCoefficientMap l E X)).obj M)
            ).IsFiniteLocallyFree) ∧
    (∀ (N : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (PbcIntegralRing l E)),
      Module.FinitePresentation (PbcIntegralRing l E) N →
        Nonempty ((pbcExtend (i.hom ≫ integralRationalCoefficientMap l E X)).obj
          ((integralConstantModule X (pbcIntegralDatum l E)).obj N) ≅
            (adicLisseConstantModules X (ULift.{u + 1} E) ⋙
              pbcExtend (letI := coefficientExtensionNormedField l E
                continuousCoefficientConstantComparison X (ULift.{u + 1} E))).obj
                ((ModuleCat.extendScalars
                  (RingHom.ulift (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E).subtype)).obj N)))
